verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in Missive AI Assistant/Copilot. It runs long sessions that you can monitor in a session tab, creates drafts, answers questions from the Missive docs, and can compose, reply and translate. It can also be extended with MCP tools to act on internal systems. It runs on the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini API key. Missing for 10: a detailed documented list of the tasks the assistant can carry out on its own, clarity on whether it runs without a BYO API key, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
